categories.name: kernel
categories.evidence: Adds C and C++ API functions and types to libbitcoinkernel in src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.{h,cpp} and src/kernel/bitcoinkernel_wrapper.h, along with kernel tests in src/test/kernel/test_kernel.cpp.
categories.rationale: Adds an optional script evaluation tracer to the libbitcoinkernel C/C++ API to inspect intermediate execution states. External developers can build script debuggers and execution analyzers, and the author demonstrated this with a proof-of-concept debugger targeting rust-bitcoinkernel. While a clear addition to library functionality, it is an auxiliary developer feature rather than core block/chainstate verification and is reasonably deferrable.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Despite the Validation label and the touch to src/script/interpreter.cpp (+8/-1), the primary subject is the kernel library API and the validation changes are no-op macro stubs in normal builds.
categories.rationale: Excluded by the validation category scope, which explicitly excludes PRs whose primary subject is the kernel library API even when they touch validation or interpreter files, provided validation logic is not substantively changed.
